summary: Probabilistic collision-geometry control, distribution-level inverse problems, and robustness-oriented physics ML are the strongest themes. The best heavy-ion-specific AI/ML contributions are IPD centrality/geometry inference and NN+MaxEnt distribution reconstruction. CME and neutron-skin papers are relevant but model-sensitive.
strongest_paper: 2608.14045: Bayesian event-by-event collision-geometry inference from charged-particle multiplicity, with UrQMD-MCG closure for net-proton cumulants.

papers.title: Bayesian inference of event-by-event collision geometry from charged-particle multiplicity in heavy-ion collisions
papers.authors_short: Yige Huang, Fu-Peng Li, Hanwen Feng, Nu Xu
papers.abstract: Bayesian posterior inference of Npart and Ncoll from charged-particle multiplicity using MCG priors and negative-binomial likelihoods; UrQMD-MCG closure improves net-proton cumulant reconstruction.

papers.title: Neural network maximum entropy framework for distribution reconstruction in heavy-ion collisions
papers.authors_short: Qian-Ru Lin, Fu-Peng Li, YiGe Huang, Long-Gang Pang
papers.abstract: NN+MaxEnt reconstructs positive normalized distributions from limited observables, with closure tests and jet-energy-loss extraction from Pb+Pb jet RAA.

papers.title: Extraction of Neutron-Skin Parameters in Zr+Zr and Ru+Ru Collisions at sqrt(sNN)=200 GeV
papers.authors_short: Junjian Zhou, Dongsheng Li, Fan Si, Xiujun Li, Yifei Zhang
papers.abstract: UrQMD plus isospin-dependent Woods-Saxon scan compared with STAR data extracts a relative neutron-skin thickness and studies baryon-to-charge transport.

papers.title: Exploring the chiral magnetic effect in Au+Au collisions at sqrt(sNN)=7.7-200 GeV through Chiral Anomaly Transport
papers.authors_short: Zilin Yuan, Anping Huang, Guo-Liang Ma, Mei Huang, Guannan Xie
papers.abstract: AMPT-CAT study of CME-sensitive correlations over BES energies, using direct subtraction and event-shape selection.

papers.title: Simultaneous production of a W boson and a charmed hadron at the LHC in general-mass variable-flavour-number scheme
papers.authors_short: Ville Alanko, Ilkka Helenius, Hannu Paukkunen
papers.abstract: NLO W+charmed-hadron production probes strange PDFs; pPb feasibility is visible but has limited nPDF constraining power.

papers.title: Unknown Unknowns: Model Misspecification in Machine Learning for Physics
papers.authors_short: Juan Cruz-Martinez, Carolina Cuesta-Lazaro, Alexander Held, Michael Kagan
papers.abstract: Discusses diagnostics and mitigation for simulation-trained ML deployed on real physics data under unanticipated misspecification.

papers.title: Contrastive Learning for Interpretable Anomaly Detection at Collider Experiments
papers.authors_short: Haoyi Jia, Sagar Addepalli, Julia Gonski
papers.abstract: ORCA combines supervised contrastive embeddings with autoencoder anomaly scores and template-fit interpretability for collider events.

papers.title: Pairton: Iterative Reconstruction of Short-Lived Particles
papers.authors_short: Andreas Hermansen, Chris Scheulen, Tobias Golling
papers.abstract: Graph masked-prediction framework for reconstructing short-lived particle decay relationships; demonstrated on fully hadronic ttbar.

papers.title: Posterior Inference of Hamiltonian Parameters from RIXS Spectroscopy
papers.authors_short: Samuel Klein, Thomas M. Linker, Louis Conreux, Daniel Ratner, Apurva Mehta, et al.
papers.abstract: Simulation-based inference with neural ratio estimation and flow matching gives validated Hamiltonian-parameter posteriors for RIXS spectroscopy.

cautions.title: Event-by-event analysis of chiral charge separation in p^up+Au collisions within an improved AMPT model
cautions.authors_short: Chen Gao, Gui-Zhen Wu, Yi Xu, Wei-Tian Deng
cautions.abstract: AMPT study of CME-induced charge separation in polarized p+Au with a model source and subsequent dilution.
cautions.reason: Useful as a sensitivity study, but model-injected signal should not be overread as evidence for CME observability in small systems.

screening.selection_rationale: Abstract-first triage selected direct heavy-ion papers and physics AI/ML papers with concrete HEP or nuclear transfer value.
